extracted.stage: Divorce proceedings, litigant in person, hearing listed
extracted.summary: Oliver, a litigant in person in divorce proceedings, asks to borrow around £20,000 to instruct representation, with roughly £270,500 of matrimonial assets (house and pension) in dispute and a hearing on 24 December.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for contacting Lodestar Legal Finance about funding for your divorce proceedings. We have noted that you are currently representing yourself, that you are seeking around £20,000, and that there is a hearing listed for 24 December. To take this further we would need confirmation of where the proceedings are taking place, details of the solicitor you intend to instruct and their estimated costs, and supporting information on the assets in dispute, including the property and pension figures. It would also help to know the current stage of the proceedings and whether any financial disclosure has been exchanged. Once we have those details, a member of our team will review your enquiry and come back to you.
